title: Send a client to another route
summary: NestJS: Send a client to another route. Inspect the initial 302 response.
introduction: @Redirect sends a location to the client. A browser following GET /start ends at /hello.
learningObjectives: Send a client to another route with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.
Send a client to another route

blocks.title: Send a client to another route

blocks.text: Redirect sends a 302 with /hello as its location. The browser then requests the greeting route.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A redirect makes the client send a new request.
